## Checklist

<!-- Retain all eight expectations. Check only verified completed items. For an inapplicable item, leave it unchecked and add “N/A — <reason>”; do not silently remove it or pre-check N/A. -->

- [ ] Ticket acceptance criteria are checked and met
- [ ] GitHub labels are assigned
- [ ] Related ticket / issue is linked with the PR
- [ ] Designated PR reviewers are set
- [ ] Tested by another **human** developer (identify evidence; AI review does not satisfy this)
- [ ] Changelog / version updated **only for requested release preparation** (otherwise N/A with reason)
- [ ] Documentation updated (see [documentation guidelines](../doc/guidelines/doc_guidelines.md), or N/A with reason)
- [ ] All PR comments are resolved / answered (distinguish addressed comments from unresolved findings)
